Deprecated: make_staninput

Source: R/deprecated-make-staninput.R
make_staninput.Rd

make_staninput() was deprecated in MVBeliefUpdatr 0.1.0 and will be removed in 0.2.0. Please use new_ideal_adaptor_stanfit_input() instead.

make_ideal_adaptor_stanfit_input() was deprecated in MVBeliefUpdatr 0.1.0 and will be removed in 0.2.0. Please use new_ideal_adaptor_stanfit_input() instead.

Usage

make_staninput(
  exposure,
  test,
  cues,
  category = "category",
  response = "response",
  group = "group",
  group.unique = NULL,
  lapse_rate = NULL,
  mu_0 = NULL,
  Sigma_0 = NULL,
  tau_scale = NULL,
  L_omega_eta = NULL,
  control = control_staninput(),
  stanmodel = "NIW_ideal_adaptor",
  verbose = FALSE
)

make_ideal_adaptor_stanfit_input(
  exposure,
  test,
  cues,
  category = "category",
  response = "response",
  group = "group",
  group.unique = NULL,
  lapse_rate = NULL,
  mu_0 = NULL,
  Sigma_0 = NULL,
  tau_scale = NULL,
  L_omega_eta = NULL,
  control = control_staninput(),
  stanmodel = "NIW_ideal_adaptor",
  verbose = FALSE
)

Arguments

exposure

A data frame or tibble with exposure data. Each row is assumed to contain one observation.

test

A data frame or tibble with test data. Each row is assumed to contain one observation.

cues

Names of columns with cue values. These columns must be present in both exposure and test.

category

Name of the column in exposure that stores the category information. (default: "category")

response

Name of the column in test that stores the response information. (default: "response_category")

group

Name of the column in exposure and test that stores the grouping information. (default: "group")

tau_scale

Deprecated. Use priors = parameter_prior(..., class = "tau_0") in fit_ideal_adaptor instead.

L_omega_eta

Deprecated. Use priors = parameter_prior(..., class = "cor_0") in fit_ideal_adaptor instead.

control

A list of control parameters for the constructor, such as list(transform_type = "standardize") or produced by control_staninput().

Value

An object of class IdealAdaptorStanfitInput.

An object of class IdealAdaptorStanfitInput.

See also

new_ideal_adaptor_stanfit_input()
